# Sayed Ahmad

> Sayed Ahmad is a web developer and the founder of Sitora Web, a digital agency based in Narayanganj, Bangladesh. He builds high-performing websites, eCommerce experiences, and custom web solutions for businesses.

## Key facts
- Name: Sayed Ahmad
- Role: Web Developer & Digital Solutions Partner; Founder of Sitora Web
- Location: Narayanganj, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh
- Contact: hello@sitora.org
- Personal site: https://sayed.sitora.org
- Agency: Sitora Web — https://sitora.org
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sayedahmad-/

## What he does
- Custom website development (React/TypeScript, WordPress/WooCommerce)
- eCommerce builds: product management, checkout flows, payment integrations
- Redesigning and optimizing existing websites (performance, usability, mobile)
- Custom web applications, SaaS concepts, and MVPs
- Works with clients internationally, not only in Bangladesh
